targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - time > 600 THEN -1 ELSE lamp_hv_env_sensor END AS "HV / Env", CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - time > 600 THEN -1 ELSE lamp_laser_controller END AS "Laser", CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - time > 600 THEN -1 ELSE lamp_b_field_monitor END AS "B-field", CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - time > 600 THEN -1 ELSE lamp_omron_ups END AS "UPS", CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - time > 600 THEN -1 ELSE logic_unit_up END AS "Logic unit", CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - time > 600 THEN -1 ELSE lamp_log_backup END AS "Log backup" FROM v_daq_status ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - time > 600 THEN -1 ELSE lamp_hv_env_sensor END AS "HV / Env", CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - time > 600 THEN -1 ELSE lamp_laser_controller END AS "Laser", CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - time > 600 THEN -1 ELSE lamp_b_field_monitor END AS "B-field", CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - time > 600 THEN -1 ELSE lamp_omron_ups END AS "UPS", CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - time > 600 THEN -1 ELSE logic_unit_up END AS "Logic unit", CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - time > 600 THEN -1 ELSE lamp_log_backup END AS "Log backup" FROM v_daq_status ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - time > 600 THEN -1 ELSE COALESCE(caen_connected, -2) END AS "Link", CASE WHEN scan_running = 1 THEN 'SCANNING' || CASE WHEN scan_total > 0 THEN '  ' || scan_done || '/' || scan_total ELSE '' END ELSE 'IDLE' END AS "Scan" FROM v_daq_status ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - time > 600 THEN -1 ELSE COALESCE(caen_connected, -2) END AS "Link", CASE WHEN scan_running = 1 THEN 'SCANNING' || CASE WHEN scan_total > 0 THEN '  ' || scan_done || '/' || scan_total ELSE '' END ELSE 'IDLE' END AS "Scan" FROM v_daq_status ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: HK

targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - ts_epoch > 900 THEN -1 ELSE ping_dpb END FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'shifter' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), -2) AS "Link", (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - last_ok_epoch > 900 THEN 'STALE' WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(end_epoch, ts_epoch)) FROM hk_run) < 600 THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE 'IDLE' END FROM source_status WHERE name = 'hk_run') AS "Scan" FROM v_daq_status ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - ts_epoch > 900 THEN -1 ELSE ping_dpb END FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'shifter' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), -2) AS "Link", (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - last_ok_epoch > 900 THEN 'STALE' WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(end_epoch, ts_epoch)) FROM hk_run) < 600 THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE 'IDLE' END FROM source_status WHERE name = 'hk_run') AS "Scan" FROM v_daq_status ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Link = the HK DPB answers a ping from the Shifter PC (read only, sampled every 5 min). Scan = an HK Digitizer scan is running from DAQ Control.

panels.title: AUS (CAEN)

targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - ts_epoch > 900 THEN -1 ELSE usb_caen END FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'aus' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), -2) AS "Link", (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - ts_epoch > 900 THEN 'STALE' WHEN run_running IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN run_running = 1 OR proc_wavedump = 1 THEN 'SCANNING' WHEN run_paused = 1 THEN 'PAUSED' WHEN run_next IS NOT NULL THEN 'NEXT ' || substr(run_next, 12, 5) ELSE 'IDLE' END FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'aus' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Scan", (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - ts_epoch > 900 THEN 'STALE' WHEN COALESCE(hv_link, 0) = 0 THEN 'N/A' WHEN hv_alarm = 1 THEN 'ALARM' WHEN hv_ramp = 1 THEN 'RAMP' WHEN hv_n_on > 0 THEN 'ON  ' || hv_n_on || ' ch' ELSE 'OFF' END FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'aus' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) AS "HV", COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - ts_epoch > 900 THEN -1 ELSE ping_arm END FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'aus' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), -2) AS "Arm"
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - ts_epoch > 900 THEN -1 ELSE usb_caen END FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'aus' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), -2) AS "Link", (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - ts_epoch > 900 THEN 'STALE' WHEN run_running IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN run_running = 1 OR proc_wavedump = 1 THEN 'SCANNING' WHEN run_paused = 1 THEN 'PAUSED' WHEN run_next IS NOT NULL THEN 'NEXT ' || substr(run_next, 12, 5) ELSE 'IDLE' END FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'aus' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Scan", (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - ts_epoch > 900 THEN 'STALE' WHEN COALESCE(hv_link, 0) = 0 THEN 'N/A' WHEN hv_alarm = 1 THEN 'ALARM' WHEN hv_ramp = 1 THEN 'RAMP' WHEN hv_n_on > 0 THEN 'ON  ' || hv_n_on || ' ch' ELSE 'OFF' END FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'aus' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) AS "HV", COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - ts_epoch > 900 THEN -1 ELSE ping_arm END FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'aus' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), -2) AS "Arm"

panels.description: Read only, sampled every 5 min. Link = CAEN digitizer on the AUS PC's USB. HV = AUS CAEN HV supply (ON with the number of channels, RAMP, ALARM = trip or over-limit flag). Arm = robot arm answers ping. Scan = AUS run queue: SCANNING, NEXT with the start time of the next queued run, PAUSED, IDLE.

panels.title: AUS linear stage

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - last_ok_epoch > 900 FROM source_status WHERE name = 'aus_run'), 1) = 1 THEN 'STALE' WHEN (SELECT CAST(event AS TEXT) FROM aus_stage ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1) = 'move_start' THEN 'MOVING' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT 'PMT' || CAST(pmt AS INT) || ' (' || CAST(mm AS INT) || ' mm)' FROM aus_stage WHERE pmt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1), 'N/A') END AS "Position", COALESCE((SELECT substr(ts, 6, 11) FROM aus_stage ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1), '-') AS "Last stage log"
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - last_ok_epoch > 900 FROM source_status WHERE name = 'aus_run'), 1) = 1 THEN 'STALE' WHEN (SELECT CAST(event AS TEXT) FROM aus_stage ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1) = 'move_start' THEN 'MOVING' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT 'PMT' || CAST(pmt AS INT) || ' (' || CAST(mm AS INT) || ' mm)' FROM aus_stage WHERE pmt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1), 'N/A') END AS "Position", COALESCE((SELECT substr(ts, 6, 11) FROM aus_stage ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1), '-') AS "Last stage log"

panels.description: Read only, sampled every 5 min from the AUS terminal logs. Position = PMT the linear stage was last verified or moved to (PMT1 = 1074 mm, PMT2 = 240 mm); MOVING = a move started and its arrival is not logged yet.

targets.queryText: SELECT ((ts_epoch + 32400) / 86400) * 86400 - 32400 AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'General scan' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "General scan", SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'Stability' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Stability", SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'Manual' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Manual", SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'Self trigger (dark)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Self trigger (dark)", SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'External trigger (LDs off)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "External trigger (LDs off)", SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'Other' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Other", SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'HK Digitizer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "HK Digitizer" FROM (SELECT ts_epoch, purpose, laser_ma FROM daq_run UNION ALL SELECT ts_epoch, 'HK Digitizer', NULL FROM hk_run) WHERE ts_epoch >= CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 30 * 86400 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ((ts_epoch + 32400) / 86400) * 86400 - 32400 AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'General scan' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "General scan", SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'Stability' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Stability", SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'Manual' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Manual", SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'Self trigger (dark)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Self trigger (dark)", SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'External trigger (LDs off)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "External trigger (LDs off)", SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'Other' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Other", SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(purpose AS TEXT), ''), 'Other') = 'HK Digitizer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "HK Digitizer" FROM (SELECT ts_epoch, purpose, laser_ma FROM daq_run UNION ALL SELECT ts_epoch, 'HK Digitizer', NULL FROM hk_run) WHERE ts_epoch >= CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 30 * 86400 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText: SELECT ((ts_epoch + 32400) / 86400) * 86400 - 32400 AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN type LIKE '%PMT Scan%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "PMT scan", SUM(CASE WHEN type LIKE 'Dark Rate%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Dark rate", SUM(CASE WHEN type LIKE 'Test%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Test", SUM(CASE WHEN type LIKE 'Move Linear%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Stage move", SUM(CASE WHEN type LIKE '%PMT Scan%' OR type LIKE 'Dark Rate%' OR type LIKE 'Test%' OR type LIKE 'Move Linear%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS "Other" FROM aus_run WHERE ts_epoch >= CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 30 * 86400 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ((ts_epoch + 32400) / 86400) * 86400 - 32400 AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN type LIKE '%PMT Scan%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "PMT scan", SUM(CASE WHEN type LIKE 'Dark Rate%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Dark rate", SUM(CASE WHEN type LIKE 'Test%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Test", SUM(CASE WHEN type LIKE 'Move Linear%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Stage move", SUM(CASE WHEN type LIKE '%PMT Scan%' OR type LIKE 'Dark Rate%' OR type LIKE 'Test%' OR type LIKE 'Move Linear%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS "Other" FROM aus_run WHERE ts_epoch >= CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 30 * 86400 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText: SELECT scan_id || COALESCE(' ' || NULLIF(MAX(scan_label), ''), '') AS scan, substr(MIN(ts), 6, 11) AS start, substr(MAX(ts), 6, 11) AS "end", CAST(MAX(CAST(wavelength AS INT)) AS TEXT) || ' nm' AS wl, COUNT(*) || ' / ' || COALESCE(MAX(CAST(scan_points AS INT)), 46) AS runs, CASE WHEN (SELECT active_scan IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - ts_epoch < 300 FROM daq_status ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) AND MAX(ts_epoch) = (SELECT MAX(ts_epoch) FROM daq_run WHERE scan_id IS NOT NULL AND scan_id != '') AND MAX(ts_epoch) > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(ts_epoch) FROM daq_status WHERE active_scan IS NULL), 0) THEN 'Running' WHEN COUNT(*) >= COALESCE(MAX(CAST(scan_points AS INT)), 46) THEN 'Complete' ELSE 'Interrupted' END AS status, MIN(100.0 * COUNT(*) / COALESCE(MAX(CAST(scan_points AS INT)), 46), 100) AS complete FROM daq_run WHERE scan_id IS NOT NULL AND scan_id != '' GROUP BY scan_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(rot2 AS TEXT) || '/' || CAST(tilt2 AS TEXT)) > 1 ORDER BY MIN(ts_epoch) DESC LIMIT 15
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT scan_id || COALESCE(' ' || NULLIF(MAX(scan_label), ''), '') AS scan, substr(MIN(ts), 6, 11) AS start, substr(MAX(ts), 6, 11) AS "end", CAST(MAX(CAST(wavelength AS INT)) AS TEXT) || ' nm' AS wl, COUNT(*) || ' / ' || COALESCE(MAX(CAST(scan_points AS INT)), 46) AS runs, CASE WHEN (SELECT active_scan IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - ts_epoch < 300 FROM daq_status ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) AND MAX(ts_epoch) = (SELECT MAX(ts_epoch) FROM daq_run WHERE scan_id IS NOT NULL AND scan_id != '') AND MAX(ts_epoch) > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(ts_epoch) FROM daq_status WHERE active_scan IS NULL), 0) THEN 'Running' WHEN COUNT(*) >= COALESCE(MAX(CAST(scan_points AS INT)), 46) THEN 'Complete' ELSE 'Interrupted' END AS status, MIN(100.0 * COUNT(*) / COALESCE(MAX(CAST(scan_points AS INT)), 46), 100) AS complete FROM daq_run WHERE scan_id IS NOT NULL AND scan_id != '' GROUP BY scan_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(rot2 AS TEXT) || '/' || CAST(tilt2 AS TEXT)) > 1 ORDER BY MIN(ts_epoch) DESC LIMIT 15

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(run AS TEXT) AS run, COALESCE(substr(datetime(start_epoch, 'unixepoch', 'localtime'), 6, 11), '-') AS start, substr(ts, 6, 11) AS "end", CASE WHEN instr(type, ' [') > 0 THEN substr(type, 1, instr(type, ' [') - 1) ELSE CAST(type AS TEXT) END AS type, CAST(pmts AS TEXT) AS pmt, COALESCE('PMT' || CAST(stage_pmt AS INT), '-') AS stage, CAST(status AS TEXT) AS status FROM aus_run ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 15
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(run AS TEXT) AS run, COALESCE(substr(datetime(start_epoch, 'unixepoch', 'localtime'), 6, 11), '-') AS start, substr(ts, 6, 11) AS "end", CASE WHEN instr(type, ' [') > 0 THEN substr(type, 1, instr(type, ' [') - 1) ELSE CAST(type AS TEXT) END AS type, CAST(pmts AS TEXT) AS pmt, COALESCE('PMT' || CAST(stage_pmt AS INT), '-') AS stage, CAST(status AS TEXT) AS status FROM aus_run ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 15

targets.queryText: SELECT (SELECT CAST(routine AS TEXT) FROM routine_now LIMIT 1) AS "Routine", COALESCE((SELECT CAST(step AS TEXT) FROM routine_now WHERE status = 'Running' LIMIT 1), 'Idle') AS "Now", COALESCE((SELECT CAST(step AS TEXT) || ' (' || CAST(plan AS TEXT) || ')' FROM routine_now WHERE status = 'Pending' AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY idx LIMIT 1), '-') AS "Next", COALESCE((SELECT CAST(routine AS TEXT) || ' ' || CAST(result AS TEXT) || ', ' || substr(run_start, 6, 11) FROM routine_run ORDER BY run_start DESC LIMIT 1), '-') AS "Last run"
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (SELECT CAST(routine AS TEXT) FROM routine_now LIMIT 1) AS "Routine", COALESCE((SELECT CAST(step AS TEXT) FROM routine_now WHERE status = 'Running' LIMIT 1), 'Idle') AS "Now", COALESCE((SELECT CAST(step AS TEXT) || ' (' || CAST(plan AS TEXT) || ')' FROM routine_now WHERE status = 'Pending' AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY idx LIMIT 1), '-') AS "Next", COALESCE((SELECT CAST(routine AS TEXT) || ' ' || CAST(result AS TEXT) || ', ' || substr(run_start, 6, 11) FROM routine_run ORDER BY run_start DESC LIMIT 1), '-') AS "Last run"

panels.title: AUS schedule

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - last_ok_epoch > 900 FROM source_status WHERE name = 'aus_telemetry'), 1) = 1 THEN 'STALE' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) || ' runs, ' || SUM(status = 'pending') || ' pending' || CASE WHEN MAX(paused) = 1 THEN ' (PAUSED)' ELSE '' END FROM aus_sched), 'empty') END AS "Queue", COALESCE((SELECT CAST(name AS TEXT) FROM aus_sched WHERE status = 'running' LIMIT 1), 'Idle') AS "Now", COALESCE((SELECT CAST(name AS TEXT) || ' (' || substr(plan, 6, 11) || ')' FROM aus_sched WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY plan_epoch LIMIT 1), '-') AS "Next", COALESCE((SELECT CAST(name AS TEXT) || ' ' || CAST(status AS TEXT) || ', ' || substr(finished, 6, 11) FROM aus_sched WHERE end_epoch IS NOT NULL ORDER BY end_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), '-') AS "Last run"
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - last_ok_epoch > 900 FROM source_status WHERE name = 'aus_telemetry'), 1) = 1 THEN 'STALE' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) || ' runs, ' || SUM(status = 'pending') || ' pending' || CASE WHEN MAX(paused) = 1 THEN ' (PAUSED)' ELSE '' END FROM aus_sched), 'empty') END AS "Queue", COALESCE((SELECT CAST(name AS TEXT) FROM aus_sched WHERE status = 'running' LIMIT 1), 'Idle') AS "Now", COALESCE((SELECT CAST(name AS TEXT) || ' (' || substr(plan, 6, 11) || ')' FROM aus_sched WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY plan_epoch LIMIT 1), '-') AS "Next", COALESCE((SELECT CAST(name AS TEXT) || ' ' || CAST(status AS TEXT) || ', ' || substr(finished, 6, 11) FROM aus_sched WHERE end_epoch IS NOT NULL ORDER BY end_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), '-') AS "Last run"

panels.description: Read only, sampled every 5 min from the AUS scheduler queue (scheduled_runs.json). The queue keeps finished runs until the AUS operator clears it.

targets.queryText: SELECT idx + 1 AS "#", CAST(step AS TEXT) AS step, CAST(plan AS TEXT) AS start, CAST(status AS TEXT) AS status, substr(started, 6, 11) AS started, substr(finished, 6, 11) AS finished, CAST(note AS TEXT) AS note FROM routine_now ORDER BY idx
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT idx + 1 AS "#", CAST(step AS TEXT) AS step, CAST(plan AS TEXT) AS start, CAST(status AS TEXT) AS status, substr(started, 6, 11) AS started, substr(finished, 6, 11) AS finished, CAST(note AS TEXT) AS note FROM routine_now ORDER BY idx

targets.queryText: SELECT idx + 1 AS "#", CAST(name AS TEXT) AS run, substr(plan, 6, 11) AS start, CAST(status AS TEXT) AS status, substr(started, 6, 11) AS started, substr(finished, 6, 11) AS finished, CAST(type AS TEXT) || '  ' || COALESCE(CAST(serial AS TEXT), '') || COALESCE('  @PMT' || CAST(stage_pmt AS INT), '') || CASE WHEN COALESCE(note, '') != '' THEN '  - ' || CAST(note AS TEXT) ELSE '' END AS note FROM aus_sched ORDER BY idx
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT idx + 1 AS "#", CAST(name AS TEXT) AS run, substr(plan, 6, 11) AS start, CAST(status AS TEXT) AS status, substr(started, 6, 11) AS started, substr(finished, 6, 11) AS finished, CAST(type AS TEXT) || '  ' || COALESCE(CAST(serial AS TEXT), '') || COALESCE('  @PMT' || CAST(stage_pmt AS INT), '') || CASE WHEN COALESCE(note, '') != '' THEN '  - ' || CAST(note AS TEXT) ELSE '' END AS note FROM aus_sched ORDER BY idx

targets.queryText: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp, 'utc') AS INTEGER) / MAX(($__to - $__from) / 600000, 1)) * MAX(($__to - $__from) / 600000, 1) AS time, AVG(Ch0_V) AS "Monitor", AVG(Ch1_V) AS "Rot1", AVG(Ch2_V) AS "Rot2" FROM monitoring_data WHERE timestamp >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AND timestamp < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AND NOT (Ch0_Stat = 4096 AND Ch1_Stat = 4096 AND Ch2_Stat = 4096 AND Ch3_Stat = 4096 AND COALESCE(Ch0_V, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(Ch1_V, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(Ch2_V, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(Ch3_V, 0) = 0) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp, 'utc') AS INTEGER) / MAX(($__to - $__from) / 600000, 1)) * MAX(($__to - $__from) / 600000, 1) AS time, AVG(Ch0_V) AS "Monitor", AVG(Ch1_V) AS "Rot1", AVG(Ch2_V) AS "Rot2" FROM monitoring_data WHERE timestamp >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AND timestamp < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AND NOT (Ch0_Stat = 4096 AND Ch1_Stat = 4096 AND Ch2_Stat = 4096 AND Ch3_Stat = 4096 AND COALESCE(Ch0_V, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(Ch1_V, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(Ch2_V, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(Ch3_V, 0) = 0) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText: SELECT (ts_epoch / MAX(($__to - $__from) / 600000, 1)) * MAX(($__to - $__from) / 600000, 1) AS time, AVG(caen_ch1_v_mon) AS "ch1", AVG(caen_ch2_v_mon) AS "ch2", AVG(caen_ch3_v_mon) AS "ch3" FROM aus_telemetry WHERE ts_epoch >= $__from / 1000 AND ts_epoch < $__to / 1000  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp, 'utc') AS INTEGER) / MAX(($__to - $__from) / 600000, 1)) * MAX(($__to - $__from) / 600000, 1) AS time, AVG(Ch0_I_H) AS "Monitor", AVG(Ch1_I_H) AS "Rot1", AVG(Ch2_I_H) AS "Rot2" FROM monitoring_data WHERE timestamp >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AND timestamp < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AND NOT (Ch0_Stat = 4096 AND Ch1_Stat = 4096 AND Ch2_Stat = 4096 AND Ch3_Stat = 4096 AND COALESCE(Ch0_V, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(Ch1_V, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(Ch2_V, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(Ch3_V, 0) = 0) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText: SELECT (SELECT disk_root_pct FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'kor' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) AS "KOR root", (SELECT disk_root_pct FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'shifter' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Shifter root", (SELECT disk_c_pct FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'bfield' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) AS "B-field C:", (SELECT disk_root_pct FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'aus' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) AS "AUS root", CASE WHEN (SELECT mount_ext_hdd FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'kor' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) = 0 THEN -1 ELSE (SELECT disk_ext_hdd_pct FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'kor' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) END AS "KOR ext HDD", CASE WHEN (SELECT mount_rawdata FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'shifter' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) = 0 THEN -1 ELSE (SELECT disk_rawdata_pct FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'shifter' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) END AS "Shifter rawdata"

targets.queryText: SELECT (ts_epoch / MAX(($__to - $__from) / 600000, 1)) * MAX(($__to - $__from) / 600000, 1) AS time, AVG(CASE WHEN host = 'kor' THEN cpu_pct END) AS "KOR", AVG(CASE WHEN host = 'bfield' THEN cpu_pct END) AS "B-field", AVG(CASE WHEN host = 'shifter' THEN cpu_pct END) AS "Shifter", AVG(CASE WHEN host = 'aus' THEN cpu_pct END) AS "AUS" FROM pc_health WHERE ts_epoch >= $__from / 1000 AND ts_epoch < $__to / 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText: SELECT unit_ups_guard_service AS "UPS guard", unit_remote_ops_service AS "Remote page", unit_daq_data_monitoring_service AS "Data monitor :8090", unit_network_watchdog_timer AS "Supervisor", unit_bfield_log_sync_timer AS "B-field sync", unit_backup_logs_timer AS "Log backup", unit_precal_monitor_timer AS "Collector", (SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - last_ok_epoch > 3 * COALESCE(period_s, 60) + 60) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM source_status) AS "Collector data" FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'kor' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1
